headline: European soccer live updates: Premier League action continues after Hull stun Man United
description: Manchester United and Real Madrid are among the clubs in action during a full set of matches across Europe on Saturday.

headline: Andy Burnham unable to sit in usual Everton seat after becoming Prime Minister
description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham took an afternoon off from running the country to watch his beloved Everton play Crystal Palace at Hill Dickinson Stadium.

headline: Michael Carrick: Man United should not panic after humbling Hull defeat
description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick insisted it was not the time to panic despite watching his team fall to a humbling 2-0 defeat to newly-promoted Hull City on Saturday.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool eye Endrick in case Minteh deal fails
description: Liverpool want Brighton's Yankuba Minteh, but they have a plan should they fail to make a deal. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Too soon to panic? Man United see problems exposed in Hull City defeat
description: Was Man United's season-opening defeat to newly promoted Hull City a bump in the road or a warning sign of a difficult campaign to come?

headline: Ian Wright: Gabriel Martinelli deserves 'more respect' at Arsenal
description: Ian Wright said Arsenal's handling of Gabriel Martinelli's potential exit from the club has left him feeling "uncomfortable" and claimed the forward deserves "more respect."
